3500.title: ACP local-file transport
3500.rootCauseOneLine: ACP maps local files to resource links without a text fallback; OpenCode rejection and persisted-history poisoning remain unverified.
3500.proposedFix: Validate an OpenCode-specific staged-path fallback and separately test recovery of previously rejected session history.
3500.caveats: Only the repository fake ACP agent was executed. The bridge transport precursor is verified, but the real OpenCode exception and later-turn poisoning are not.
